name: Midaraninden Sakura Ryouran
original_name: 淫忍伝 さくら繚乱
source:
Daidabashi Kenzo is your usual student living on his own...
His only real concern is that he can't get "it" up....
Carrying the weight of his burdens, one day Kenzo discovers a girl, asleep, and clinging to his ceiling!
The girl, called Kugeyama Sakura, explains that she's a ninja, sent to protect a seal placed on Kenzo's body.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE031751.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
代田桥谦三只是一名独居的普通学生……
唯一真正令他烦恼的是，那里怎么也硬不起来……
背负着沉重烦恼的谦三，某天发现一名沉睡的女孩竟紧贴在天花板上！
女孩名叫久我山さくら，自称是一名忍者，奉命保护施加在谦三身体上的封印。

[译自 [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE031751.html]DLsite English[/url]]
